title: Classification of Class-VII Complex Surfaces
exact_target: Classify compact complex surfaces of class $\mathrm{VII}_0^+$: minimal compact complex surfaces with first Betti number one, negative Kodaira dimension, and positive second Betti number. Determine their geometric structure.
